title: Add copy button for raw PDF output per pay stub
description: Add a copy-to-clipboard button for each pay stub that copies the raw PDF text output. This is useful for debugging parsing issues. The raw text is already available from the parser - just need to expose it in the UI with a copy button.
close_reason: Redesigned import preview with concise row-based UI, expandable details, validation warnings, and copy button for raw PDF text

title: Fix duplicate detection for same-date pay stubs
description: Two pay stubs with same period/date but different amounts are rejected due to UNIQUE(period_start, period_end, pay_date) constraint in DB. Need to include gross_earnings in uniqueness check.
close_reason: Added migration 004 to include gross_earnings in unique constraint, allowing multiple pay stubs on same date with different amounts

title: Show parallel import progress for pay stubs
description: Update pay statement import UI to show parallel progress instead of sequential. Currently files are processed one at a time in the UI even though backend supports 5-file batch concurrency. Show progress for multiple files being processed simultaneously with individual status indicators.
close_reason: Implemented parallel import progress with individual file status tracking

title: Simplify pay stub import UI - concise view with warnings
description: Redesign the pay statement import preview to be more concise. Current UI is cluttered with too much detail. Show a clean summary with: filename, pay date, net pay, and status. Highlight warnings and errors prominently. Collapse detailed breakdowns into expandable sections.
close_reason: Redesigned import preview with concise row-based UI, expandable details, validation warnings, and copy button for raw PDF text
